The '''''Valcyn''''' was a [[T-class long-range personal cruiser/Legends|''T''-class long-range personal cruiser]] gifted to [[Qordis]] by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Skere Kaan|Kaan]] for his work with the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]] at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. The ''Valcyn'' was one of the finest vessels in the [[Sith fleet (New Sith Wars)|Sith fleet]]. It was equipped with the latest and advanced technology at the time.<ref name="PoD" />

==History==
[[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] stole the ''Valcyn'' from [[Qordis]]' personal docking bay when he left the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. He piloted the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in his travels to [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]], [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]], and [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]]<ref name="PoD" /> before crashing it on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], destroying it in the process.<ref name="RoT" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Valcyn'' was also the name of a server - or "Galaxy" - in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.
